comments.text: The reality of living here is slightly different. Yes it's still cheap but with the plummeting dollar and price increases pretty much across the board, even rents, it's getting a bit more complicated. The food at those correntazos, is affordable, but you get what you pay for. The food for me is just average and in some cases very bad. Forget international food. I am biased since I'm from NYC. The chinese food is terrible, mexican is below average and italian food is just not good. Seafood on the coast (Santa Marta, Cartagena) is outstanding. Otherwise, you have to visit an extremely expensive restaurant, by colombian standards, to get a good meal, but no guarantee.
